iterations.hypothesis: Implement DCN-v2 to explore explicit bounded-degree feature crosses.
iterations.rationale: DCN-v2 can capture complex feature interactions that are not captured by simple linear models, potentially improving the within-user ranking by better understanding the interactions between user and item features.

--- a/pipeline/models.py
+++ b/pipeline/models.py
@@ -142,6 +142,39 @@
 # =========================================================================
 # Torch models
 # =========================================================================
+
+class DCNv2Model(nn.Module):
+    """Deep & Cross Network v2 for capturing bounded-degree feature crosses."""
+
+    def __init__(self, num_features: int, num_fields: int, embed_dim: int = 16,
+                 num_cross_layers: int = 3, hidden_dims: List[int] = [128, 64], dropout: float = 0.2):
+        super().__init__()
+        self.linear = nn.Embedding(num_features, 1)
+        self.factors = nn.Embedding(num_features, embed_dim)
+        self.bias = nn.Parameter(torch.zeros(1))
+        nn.init.zeros_(self.linear.weight)
+        nn.init.normal_(self.factors.weight, std=0.01)
+
+        # Cross Network
+        self.cross_layers = nn.ModuleList([nn.Linear(num_fields * embed_dim, 1) for _ in range(num_cross_layers)])
+
+        # Deep Network
+        dim = num_fields * embed_dim
+        layers: List[nn.Module] = []
+        for h in hidden_dims:
+            layers += [nn.Linear(dim, h), nn.BatchNorm1d(h), nn.ReLU(), nn.Dropout(dropout)]
+            dim = h
+        layers.append(nn.Linear(dim, 1))
+        self.deep_network = nn.Sequential(*layers)
+
+    def forward(self, x_cat: torch.Tensor) -> torch.Tensor:
+        vx = self.factors(x_cat).flatten(1)
+        cross_term = vx
+        for layer in self.cross_layers:
+            cross_term = cross_term + layer(cross_term * vx)
+
+        deep_term = self.deep_network(vx).squeeze(1)
+        return self.linear(x_cat).sum((1, 2)) + self.bias + cross_term.sum(1) + deep_term

 # =========================================================================
 # Torch models
 # =========================================================================
+
+class DCNv2Model(nn.Module):
+    """Deep & Cross Network v2 for capturing bounded-degree feature crosses."""
+
+    def __init__(self, num_features: int, num_fields: int, embed_dim: int = 16,
+                 num_cross_layers: int = 3, hidden_dims: List[int] = [128, 64], dropout: float = 0.2):
+        super().__init__()
+        self.linear = nn.Embedding(num_features, 1)
+        self.factors = nn.Embedding(num_features, embed_dim)
+        self.bias = nn.Parameter(torch.zeros(1))
+        nn.init.zeros_(self.linear.weight)
+        nn.init.normal_(self.factors.weight, std=0.01)
+
+        # Cross Network
+        self.cross_layers = nn.ModuleList([nn.Linear(num_fields * embed_dim, 1) for _ in range(num_cross_layers)])
+
+        # Deep Network
+        dim = num_fields * embed_dim
+        layers: List[nn.Module] = []
+        for h in hidden_dims:
+            layers += [nn.Linear(dim, h), nn.BatchNorm1d(h), nn.ReLU(), nn.Dropout(dropout)]
+            dim = h
+        layers.append(nn.Linear(dim, 1))
+        self.deep_network = nn.Sequential(*layers)
+
+    def forward(self, x_cat: torch.Tensor) -> torch.Tensor:
+        vx = self.factors(x_cat).flatten(1)
+        cross_term = vx
+        for layer in self.cross_layers:
+            cross_term = cross_term + layer(cross_term * vx)
+
+        deep_term = self.deep_network(vx).squeeze(1)
+        return self.linear(x_cat).sum((1, 2)) + self.bias + cross_term.sum(1) + deep_term
